inlines.v: GEOMET'RIC GEOMET'RICAL, adjective [Gr.] Pertaining to geometry. 1. According to the rules or principles of geometry; done by geometry. 2. Disposed according to geometry. Geometrical progression, is when the terms increase or decrease by equal ratios; as 2.4.8.16.32. or 32.16.8.4.2.
